verdict.rationale: Delegated third-party access is a fair question for an entity-registration system like SAM.gov, so the axis applies. However, the evidence only covers API access tiers (Public/FOUO/Sensitive by account sensitivity) and individual versus system accounts. Nothing documents third-party authorization forms, delegate roles, or which signatures must stay personal, and API account tiers are an adjacent control, not published delegation rules.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, exactly what a third party may and may not do on my behalf is published — the authorization forms, the roles, and which signatures stay personal
